text.h01: [warmly] You made it! It's hot, isn't it. There — nice and cold?
text.h02: [softly] A towel wrung out in well water. Cool your neck with it.
text.g01: [laughs] Ha ha ha! You're here, you're here! Grandpa's cooling a watermelon in the river!
text.g02: [excited] Heave-ho! Look at this, look how big!
text.g03: [proud] How's that, cold, eh? Right on your cheek!
text.h03: [laughs] Now, Grandpa. You'll give them a fright.
text.g04: [excited] Right, watermelon splitting! Blindfold on with the towel.
text.g05: [shouting] A bit more to the right! Right, right!
text.g07: [laughs] Ha ha ha! So close! One more time!
text.g08: [excited] Split it clean in two! Well done!
text.h05: [softly] Come, eat up. You can spit the seeds into the garden.
text.g09: [proud] At seed-spitting, Grandpa's the best in the village!
text.h06: [softly] …Here, let me fan you. Flap, flap.
text.h07: [whispers] …You know, when Grandpa was young, he never once hit the melon. …That's our secret.
text.g12: [softly] Cup one gently in your hands. …Don't squash it.
text.h09: [softly] It's cool inside the mosquito net. I'll leave the fan running.
